title: Port the control profile fep-0005 to the TypeScript and Rust SDKs (gap G-1)
notes: sdk/typescript/src/profiles/fep0005.ts + sdk/rust/src/profiles/fep0005.rs: ports of fidetype.conformance.profiles.fep0005 and the fidetype.trust.control validators (FEP5-DECL/CONTROL/ENABLE/INTENT/TD-FORMAT/TD-ORDER/SAFETY). Registered in CONSUMERS / consumer_for, so CLIs, parity scripts and CI parity jobs include fep-0005 without a list change. Consumer acted list (spec 6.4): moving_ticks + acted_intents + acted_texts. Rust no_std + alloc (libm only; thumbv7em build pass); TS zero runtime deps. Python behaviours copied: pointer dims true == 1; overflowing speed square (OverflowError) = reject. Python = TS = Rust 279/279 vectors; fuzz seeds 1-6 --n 30: 44,196 mutants (fep-0005 7,560) identical; extra fep-0005-only seeds 11-13 --n 300 (37,800) identical. No Python bug, no vector change. pytest 786 passed / 10 skipped; npm test 32; cargo test pass. Spec RC2 1.1/9.3/9.5/11.7/C.2 (G-1 closed), CHANGELOG, READMEs, wiki. Review points: CTL-S7 checked only after a stop decision; 7.4.5 notes (p_top1 null, score_semantics by radius) unchecked.
